review:
Ra vs Anubis on 14 lines. Golden Scarab wilds that join a win expand up or down depending on which god wins, creating big wild areas; ones that don't expand count as single wilds.

When a scarab expands over a WILD symbol, a multiplier of up to 200x applies to the whole area, and several in one win add together. Three to five FS trigger the bonus games. Rated 3/5, 10,000x max, RTP versions from 96.20% down to 88.24%.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 88.24% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
